derivation: the main flow works. 1 thing in the build does not match what you asked for — the mix-ratio status line (t-3-ac1) — and none of them is from the PRD itself: worth reading before you merge.

criteria.text: The board shows every recorded grout batch in one list on the page.
criteria.note: Every batch sits in one list right under the header — B-1041, B-1042 and B-1043, one line each, on the dark panel.

criteria.text: A new batch can be added from the board itself, without leaving the page.
criteria.note: The add row is right there on the same screen — a 'new batch code' input with an ADD BATCH button beside it, no navigation away.

criteria.text: The board names itself in a header so the tiler knows what he is looking at.
criteria.note: The orange band across the top reads GROUT TRACKER (background rgb(224,138,60)), just as the drawing has it.

criteria.text: The batch list is the first thing under the header.
criteria.note: The list opens at y=71, directly beneath the header that ends at y=51 — nothing sits between them.

criteria.text: An ADD BATCH button sits to the right of the input.
criteria.note: ADD BATCH is to the right of the input on the same row — the input runs from x=20 out to x=1283, and the button starts at x=1293.

criteria.text: A status line beneath the add row shows the current mix ratio.
criteria.note: Your drawing has an orange mix-ratio line ('MIX RATIO 3:1 · 2 BATCHES OPEN') sitting beneath the add row. It isn't there at all — below the add row the page goes straight to the footer.
No screen can settle this, but your own suite covers it and it passes.

criteria.text: The export writes valid CSV with a header row.
criteria.note: I could not check this. Your suite is green, but its CSV lines are about parsing quoted commas, loading fixtures and header-row theme styling — nothing in it shows the export writing valid CSV with a header row, and no screen surface shows it either.

gaps.title: the mix-ratio status line
gaps.expected: an orange mix-ratio line beneath the add row showing the current ratio and open-batch count
gaps.saw: nothing there — below the add row the page drops straight to the 'grout tracker · sandbox build' footer

alsoChecked: The ADD BATCH button is teal (rgb(90,166,184)); your drawing doesn't say what colour it should be, so I'm treating that as the builder's call.
There is a footer reading 'grout tracker · sandbox build' at the bottom; the drawing says nothing about a footer, so that's the builder's call, not a fault.
No console errors were reported on the page.
summary: Captain, the core of the board is here and matches your drawing: the orange GROUT TRACKER header, the batch list directly beneath it, and an add row with the ADD BATCH button to the right of the input — your three PRD goals all hold. The one real miss is the status line: your drawing puts an orange mix-ratio line under the add row, and the build simply doesn't have it — it goes straight to the footer. Persistence passes your own tests; the CSV-export claim I couldn't confirm, because neither the screen nor the suite actually exercises writing a CSV with a header row.
